column3: Sharp nearest-neighbor threshold for every d>6 requires lace-expansion-scale percolation estimates; spread-out theorem does not cover the stated model.
Efficient optimal filtering is requested with approximate sizes and no precise approximation/error/computational model; sparse Kalman heuristics do not solve the literal task.
Kunis–Reichenwallner–Reitzner 1612.01893v1 Theorem 1 negates exactly the universal 3D inclusion assertion; Proposition 1 and degree-26 majorant conclusion already give the mechanism.
Classify every possible standard gamma for arbitrary Y and n; stable or Gaussian examples cover only subclasses and do not supply the classification.
Literal record states a full log-canonical extension theorem rather than a new construction; no proof body read here, so park rather than infer newness from open status.
Record itself reports polynomial-time solvability for tree-distance weights; implementing a fixed instance would not be a new algorithmic theorem.
Versality recognition quantifies over all generically free varieties and all invariant dense opens; no finite test or tractable full-scope mechanism established.
Record expressly calls the Frobenius-number limit formula a theorem; deriving d=3 or simulating distributions adds no full new outcome.
Minimal-mass NLS blow-up existence and uniqueness for every permitted energy requires nonlinear concentration analysis; constant-k shortcuts violate the negative-Hessian hypothesis.
Di Rocco–Jabbusch–Smith 1409.3109v1 Example 4.6 gives rank-three H on P2 with tau=1 but no 1-jet separation; the literal all-k implication is already false.
Record already attributes the impossibility for arbitrary conflict graphs to Shah–Tse–Tsitsiklis under a computational hypothesis; no unconditional new obstruction supplied.

Classical Plateau minimization; regularity and boundary-homeomorphism details must follow original definitions, and manipulating those details would be a formulation correction rather than a new resolution.
Record already supplies the full k>=3 counterexample assertion with r2=4; another small convexity space cannot earn discovery credit from this record.
Exponential influence for a linear-size coalition needs uniform all-Boolean-function bounds; a finite n rounding obstruction or special function is not substantive full-scope progress.
Wheel-free chi-boundedness is a structural graph-class theorem; checking small graphs cannot certify existence or absence of a universal binding function.
Full colored Tverberg assertion for all d and r; prime/prime-power or low-dimensional cases are not the stated universal claim.

Original report and Pach–Toth survey explicitly conjecture all cover-decomposable P, while proving polygon subclasses. Splitting into two 1-covers does not preserve high multiplicity, so naive recursive splitting fails.
Zak Smith 2609.31549v1 Theorem 1.2 proves all uniformities at least four; original Problem 10 agrees. No new coloring sweep warranted.
Record states Baum–van Erp constructed the requested K-cycle; reconstructing the analytic index theorem is not a fresh target.
Both quantum ergodicity estimates are explicitly Theorem 1 in the record; malformed symbol names do not create a new theorem.
Exact real Grothendieck constant is a major sharp-constant problem; fixed matrices only give bounds and cannot determine the full supremum.
Existence of exponential-extension-complexity 0/1 polytopes is already asserted as a result; small explicit polytopes do not settle a new full-scope question.
Smallest singularity class compatible with preserving all normal crossings is a broad resolution/classification problem, with no small exact certificate mechanism found.
Uniform o(1) Poisson empirical-Bayes regret over every unrestricted prior needs integrability and uniformity assumptions checked in source; finite-prior examples do not solve it.
Literal record is already Bourgain's negative spectral result for every nonzero coupling; repairing its control-character typo receives no credit.
Asymptotic extremal equivalence over arbitrary bipartite graph families and some odd k is a full structural conjecture; forbidding finitely many small cycles experimentally is insufficient.
Optimal uniform simultaneous approximation exponent over all rationally independent power tuples requires Diophantine extremal analysis; algebraic examples give lower bounds only.
Effectivity for arbitrary finitely generated domains and all separable binary forms is a uniform arithmetic algorithm problem, not finitely many Thue–Mahler instances.
Exceptional unit runs must be controlled at every degree d>=7; checking cyclotomic units or bounded-degree polynomials cannot prove the universal degree bound.
All-dimension multiset-layer diameter bound has no source-qualified small witness or constructive proof; no high-dimensional diameter sweep performed.

Retained Brittenham 1705.05985v1 Theorems 1.2–1.3 already refute the knot specialization via a four-knot alternative. Computational enumeration dependencies not replayed and literal BJ recursion needs care; no new knot certificate proposed.
Exact total-variation recovery with the stated separation thresholds is presented as an existing guarantee; wrap-around metric/TeX repairs would not be substantive new outcomes.
Dimension-only additive spectral bound quantifies over all smooth domains and eigenvalue indices; no controlled isoperimetric degeneration yielding a literal counterexample established.
Full optimal Lieb–Thirring kinetic constant across dimensions is a major sharp spectral problem; one-state trial functions do not determine the universal constant.
Sharp stretched-exponential persistence tail in critical dynamical percolation requires a uniform temporal mechanism; finite simulations cannot establish the asymptotic exponent.
Record explicitly states well-posedness of the evolving-surface variational problem; missing definitions H and material derivative require source, not a new proof nomination.
Arbitrarily small independent density in Cartesian Kneser powers needs all-scale coding/independence analysis; a bounded power is not a full resolution.
Record explicitly says the Erdos–Fajtlowicz bound is proved; numerical graph optimization adds no discovery outcome.
Galerkin spectral convergence and spurious-mode exclusion depend on full finite-element trace/compactness theory; one mesh computation is not a numerical-analysis theorem.
Exact monomial convergence set requires resolving boundary sequences where the limsup equals one; strict-interior bounds or a single familiar sequence do not classify it.
Optimal subexponential factor is a uniform coefficient extremal asymptotic; endpoint r=1 or one polynomial is not the requested full-range sharp analysis.
Uniform Lp mean-value averaging for every degree-N Dirichlet polynomial and 1<=p<2 is an analytic localization problem; even-p estimates do not give the stated regime.
D-finiteness classification for all 3D small-step models requires both differential-equation construction and non-D-finiteness proofs; known 2D or directed subclasses cannot earn full-result credit.

Literal record says next-page Theorem 1.2 answers the multiplier-degree question. Body not retained here, so no independent verification claimed; neither q=0 loophole nor a bound specialization is a discovery.
Minimal interpolation slope for each individual stable F needs moduli/cohomology strata, not merely a general-sheaf interpolation theorem; no full-scope algorithm established.
Exact Grunbaum mass-partition function for all j,k subsumes broad topological equipartition problems; ham-sandwich and small k cases are excluded parameter instances.

Original question persists in 1412.0371v1 final questions. Universality for arbitrary bounded-polygon combinatorial types does not imply failure for the convex-position type; unrestricted-body contractibility does not imply bounded-k contractibility.
Record already states algorithmic undecidability for all finite permutoid inputs; small examples or composition-convention repairs cannot be counted.
Fixed-d polynomial-time binary-encoded bin packing is presented as a theorem; brute-force configurations are pseudopolynomial and do not furnish the stated general complexity bound.
Lie-bracket controllability alone must yield finite-Fourier piecewise-smooth vanishing feedback for every driftless system; local examples or changing coefficient symmetry would be variants.
